project_name.justification: The article is titled: "Lomiko Announces Definitive Agreement for Acquisition of the Yellow Fox, Antimony, Silver, and Gold Property located in central Newfoundland".

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified as "Lomiko Metals Inc.(TSX-V: LMR) (“Lomiko” or the “Company”)" which has entered into an agreement with Metals Creek Resources Corp. to acquire the project.

ceo_buyer.justification: Gordana Slepcev, CEO, President, and director of Lomiko, stated: “We are pleased to add another critical mineral, antimony, to our portfolio..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Lomiko can "acquire a 100% interest in 28 mineral claims forming the Yellow Fox project" and "Lomiko will acquire 100% of Metal Creek’s right, title and interest in and to the option interests".

primary_commodity.justification: The CEO of the buyer stated: "We are pleased to add another critical mineral, antimony, to our portfolio with upside potential in silver and gold."
